name: jev-ticket-triage
description: TriageDesk — support-ticket triage using TypeSafe Jev (System One model): one typed fan-out decision call per ticket, confidence-band routing, human review queue, calibration on own labels. Headless dogfood target.

seed_features.description: Bootstrap the TriageDesk MVP shell: FastAPI backend + Next.js frontend + SQLite stub + MockJevProvider behind the DecisionProvider interface. Sanity check that /auto can drive scaffold-import artifacts through generator + evaluator + E2E gate.
steps: Backend serves GET /health returning 200 OK with a JSON body {status: ok, provider: mock}

POST /tickets with body 'I was charged twice this month, please refund the duplicate' returns a decision with team=billing and a confidence in [0,1] for all six questions (DECISION_PROVIDER=mock, no network)
Frontend renders the review queue page containing text 'TriageDesk' and the shadow-mode banner
Playwright/Puppeteer MCP session verifies the review queue page loads and /health returns 200
seed_features.source_section: Jev ticket-triage fixture BRD AC1 + AC7
